one_line: A royal mint officer of the Bengal Sultans, overseeing the silver tanka economy across riverine mints like Gaur, Pandua and Sonargaon.

appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Bengali complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache and short beard framing the jaw, calm observant eyes with a sharp analytical gaze, default expression focused yet approachable
appearance.hair: black hair, kept short and tidy under a deep green, slightly tapered quilted cap (kulah) with a narrow gold band at the base
appearance.costume: a long, straight-cut jama of soft white cotton reaching mid-calf, front-opening with a subtle overlap and cloth tie at the right side, worn over loose ankle-length trousers of pale beige; a sleeveless, hip-length overcoat (qaba) in rich indigo-blue with simple narrow gold piping along the edges; around his waist a broad maroon sash tied securely with one end hanging to the left; black leather turn-down shoes with slightly upturned but modest toes; overall tailoring modest and practical, evoking late-medieval eastern Indian Islamic court attire without excessive ornament.
appearance.signature: a small leather coin-inspector’s kit in his left hand: an oblong brown leather case opened to reveal neatly stacked silver tanka coins engraved with Arabic script and mint names, plus a simple brass balance scale, while his right hand delicately holds a single bright silver tanka between thumb and forefinger.

ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown Bengali mint officer with short black hair under a deep green cap, white cotton jama, beige trousers, indigo-blue overcoat, maroon sash, black shoes, holding a leather coin kit and a silver tanka, in white, indigo, green, maroon and silver tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character: a late-20s lean Bengali mint officer standing upright, with an oval medium-brown face, neat mustache and short beard, and short black hair under a deep green slightly tapered quilted cap with a narrow gold band. He wears a long, straight white cotton jama reaching mid-calf over loose pale beige ankle-length trousers, layered with a sleeveless hip-length indigo-blue overcoat edged in narrow gold piping. A broad maroon sash wraps his waist, one end hanging to the left, and he has simple black leather turn-down shoes with modestly upturned toes. In his left hand is an open oblong brown leather coin-inspector’s kit showing stacked silver tanka coins with engraved script and a small brass balance scale; in his right hand he delicately holds a single bright silver tanka between thumb and forefinger. Use clean, consistent colors—white for the jama, indigo-blue for the overcoat, deep green for the cap, maroon for the sash, black for the shoes, and gleaming silver for the coins—presented clearly in a neutral pose so the entire face, hair, clothing, and coin kit are visible head-to-toe for a model sheet.
